content: {"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE name LIKE '%南郑中心%' LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配南郑中心，查询其设计处理规模"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 鼓风机总数, count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用鼓风机数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机';", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选鼓风机，按总数和备用状态统计"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS 厂站, capacity_m3d AS 设计规模_m3_d FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "筛选集镇厂，按设计规模降序取第一条，即设计规模最大的集镇厂"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.kind AS 设备类型, count(*) AS 数量, round(sum(d.rated_kw)::numeric, 1) AS 总额定功率_kw
FROM device d
GROUP BY d.kind
ORDER BY d.kind", "explanation": "按设备类型分组统计设备数量并对额定功率求和。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型
FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%'
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "按厂站名称模糊匹配梁山镇，关联设备表列出设备编码和类型"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.inflow_m3h::numeric) AS 进水流量_m3h
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.code = 'P01'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "取中心厂最新一条实时进水流量数据"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.mlss::numeric, 2) AS 污泥浓度MLSS
FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税镇%'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按厂站名称匹配协税镇，从 plant_reading 中取最新一条污泥浓度数据"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(r.current_a::numeric, 1) AS 电流_A
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '30 minutes'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查询中心厂1号鼓风机最近30分钟的最新运行电流"}

{"sql": "SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.id) p.name AS 厂站, r.ts AS 时间, round(r.do_aerobic_1::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区1溶解氧, round(r.do_aerobic_2::numeric, 2) AS 好氧区2溶解氧 FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts > now() - interval '30 minutes' ORDER BY p.id, r.ts DESC", "explanation": "查询各厂站最近30分钟内最新一条实时数据，返回好氧区1和2的溶解氧浓度"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.blower_kw)::numeric, 2) AS 鼓风机耗电量_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "从小时聚合表中按中心厂名称匹配，统计昨天全天的小时鼓风机功率求和得到耗电量"}

{"sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, sum(h.inflow_m3h) AS 日处理水量
  FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%'
    AND h.hour >= '2026-10-30'::timestamptz
    AND h.hour < '2026-11-05'::timestamptz
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT round(avg(日处理水量)::numeric, 2) AS 平均日处理水量_m3
FROM daily;", "explanation": "按自然日汇总梁山镇处理水量，再求6天的日均值"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS 平均进水氨氮_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "查询过去24小时各厂小时平均进水氨氮的总体平均值"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS 碳源投加量_kg, round(sum(h.pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 1) AS PAC投加量_kg FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())", "explanation": "查询本周全区小时级运行数据，分别汇总碳源和PAC投加量"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最高气温, round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 最低气温\nFROM weather\nWHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now());", "explanation": "查询昨天自然日的气温最大值和最小值"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.cod_in)::numeric, 1) AS 进水COD_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name;", "explanation": "统计中心厂今天0-12点的进水COD小时均值"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(h.air_flow_m3h)::numeric, 2) AS 平均曝气风量_m3h
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "查询中心厂昨天全天小时平均曝气风量的平均值"}

{"sql":"SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY h.hour
ORDER BY h.hour","explanation":"按小时汇总今天全区所有厂站的进水流量作为处理水量"}

{"sql":"SELECT h.hour AS 时间, round(h.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS 出水总磷均值
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days'
  AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
ORDER BY h.hour","explanation":"查询协税镇污水处理站在11月3日每小时的出水总磷小时均值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS 日期, round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均气温_℃ FROM weather WHERE ts >= make_date(extract(year FROM now())::int, 11, 1) AND ts < make_date(extract(year FROM now())::int, 11, 5) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天分组统计气象表中11月1日至4日的平均气温"}

{
  "sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 时间, round(h.cod_out::numeric, 1) AS 出水COD
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
ORDER BY h.cod_out DESC
LIMIT 1;",
  "explanation": "查询过去7天 plant_reading_1h 中出水COD最高的一条小时记录，并关联厂站名称。"
}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.carbon_dose_kgh) / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水碳源投加量_kg_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY 2 DESC", "explanation": "按过去7天各厂碳源投加总量除以处理水量，计算吨水碳源投加量并降序排列"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour)::date AS 日期, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 处理水量_m3 DESC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "按天汇总过去7天全区处理水量，排序取最大的一天"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', h.hour) AS 日期, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1", "explanation": "按天汇总中心厂本周小时数据，用鼓风机总耗电量除以处理水量计算吨水曝气电耗。"}

{"sql":"SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((sum(h.blower_kw) / sum(h.inflow_m3h))::numeric, 4) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY 2 ASC
LIMIT 2","explanation":"按本周各厂累计鼓风机电耗除以累计处理水量计算吨水曝气电耗，升序取最低的两个厂"}
{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 总磷超标小时数\nFROM plant_reading_1h\nWHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周所有厂站小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过0.5mg/L的小时数"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(h.hour) FILTER (WHERE h.cod_out > 50 OR h.nh3n_out_max > 5 OR h.tn_out > 15 OR h.tp_out_max > 0.5 OR h.ss_out > 10) AS 不达标小时数 FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h h ON h.plant_id = p.id AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id;", "explanation": "以plant表为主表左连接昨日小时数据，按厂统计五项指标任一超标的整点小时数，确保无超标厂的计数为0"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, h.hour AS 首次超标时间
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税镇%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.tp_out_max > 0.5
ORDER BY h.hour
LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "查询协税镇本周小时数据中总磷最大值超过0.5的最早小时，按时间升序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均总氮_mgL, round(max(h.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS 最大小时均值_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "查询过去7天中心厂的出水总氮小时均值的平均值和最大值"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, d.code AS 设备编码 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '备用' ORDER BY p.name, d.code LIMIT 50", "explanation": "关联设备和厂站表，筛选状态为备用的鼓风机并按厂站分组列出设备"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(*) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5) AS 氨氮超标小时数, round(max(h.nh3n_out_max) FILTER (WHERE h.nh3n_out_max > 5)::numeric, 2) AS 氨氮超标最高_mg_l FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY p.id, p.name", "explanation": "查询黄官镇昨天（11月4日）的小时级数据，按氨氮最大值>5mg/L统计超标小时数并取超标时段最高氨氮值"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(max(r.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS 最大振动_mm_s FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY max(r.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "按鼓风机分组，取最近7天振动最大值并排序。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度_摄氏度
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%'
  AND d.kind = '鼓风机'
  AND r.running
  AND r.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours'
GROUP BY d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂运行中的鼓风机，统计过去24小时每台设备的平均温度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(r.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS 平均电流_A FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%中心%' AND d.kind = '提升泵' AND r.running AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "筛选中心厂提升泵昨天的运行记录，按设备分别计算平均电流"}

{"sql": "SELECT r.ts AS 时间, round(r.vibration_mms::numeric, 2) AS 振动_mm_s
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1'
  AND r.vibration_mms > 7.1
  AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
ORDER BY r.ts ASC
LIMIT 1", "explanation": "查询黄官镇1号鼓风机（P06-BL-1）在11月4日振动值首次超过7.1 mm/s的最早记录时间"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS 停机分钟 FROM device_reading r JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id WHERE d.code = 'P06-BL-1' AND r.running = false AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "查询黄官镇1号鼓风机在昨天的停机分钟数，按每分钟一条数据统计running为false的记录数"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS 最大降雨强度_mm_h\nFROM weather\nWHERE ts >= '2026-10-31'::date AND ts < '2026-11-01'::date;", "explanation": "查询10月31日当日降雨强度的最大值"}
{"sql": "SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间, max(ts) AS 结束时间\nFROM weather\nWHERE ts >= date '2026-10-31' AND ts < date '2026-11-01' AND rain_mm_h > 0", "explanation": "查询10月31日降雨强度大于0的最早和最晚时间作为降雨起止时间"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(max(h.tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS 最高总磷
FROM plant_reading_1h h
JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税镇%'
  AND h.hour >= '2026-11-03'::date
  AND h.hour < '2026-11-04'::date
GROUP BY p.name;", "explanation": "按小时表查询协税镇在11月3日的出水总磷小时最大值，再取当天最高值。"}

{"sql":"SELECT round((sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= make_date(extract(year from now())::int,10,31) AND h.hour < make_date(extract(year from now())::int,10,31) + interval '1 day' THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) - sum(CASE WHEN h.hour >= make_date(extract(year from now())::int,10,30) AND h.hour < make_date(extract(year from now())::int,10,31) THEN h.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END))::numeric, 0) AS 多处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND h.hour >= make_date(extract(year from now())::int,10,30) AND h.hour < make_date(extract(year from now())::int,11,1)", "explanation": "按当前年份构造10月31日和10月30日的时间范围，对梁山镇的小时处理水量分别求和后相减得到增加量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())) - sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'))::numeric) AS 多处理水量_m3\nFROM plant_reading_1h h\nWHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '2 days' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "分别汇总昨天和前天的全区小时处理水量后计算差值"}

{"sql":"WITH target_day AS (SELECT date_trunc('day', ts)::date AS day FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now()) ORDER BY rain_mm_h DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h WHERE date_trunc('day', h.hour) = (SELECT day FROM target_day);","explanation":"先找出过去7个完整自然日中小时降雨强度最大的日期，再统计该日期全区处理水量。"}

{"sql": "WITH all_avg AS (
  SELECT avg(cod_in) AS avg_all
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
),
plant_avg AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.name, avg(h.cod_in) AS avg_cod
  FROM plant_reading_1h h
  JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
  WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name
)
SELECT pa.name AS 厂站, round(pa.avg_cod::numeric, 1) AS 平均进水COD
FROM plant_avg pa
CROSS JOIN all_avg aa
WHERE pa.avg_cod > aa.avg_all
ORDER BY pa.id", "explanation": "计算过去7天全区平均进水COD，再比较各厂站同期平均进水COD，筛选高于全区平均的厂站"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round((1 - avg(h.tn_out) / avg(h.tn_in))::numeric * 100, 1) AS 总氮去除率_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id", "explanation": "按过去7天各厂小时级进水总氮均值与出水总氮均值计算总氮去除率"}
{"sql": "", "explanation": "数据库中的 weather 表仅存储历史观测降雨数据，没有未来天气预报，因此无法查询下周是否下雨。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS 工艺, round(sum(h.inflow_m3h)::numeric) AS 处理水量_m3
FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id
WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND h.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.process
ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按处理工艺分组汇总昨日各厂站小时处理水量"}

{"sql":"SELECT round((sum(h.inflow_m3h) FILTER (WHERE p.kind = '中心厂') / NULLIF(sum(h.inflow_m3h), 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS 占比_百分比 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'","explanation":"汇总过去7天小时处理水量，用条件聚合计算中心厂（kind='中心厂'）水量占全部厂站水量的百分比。"}

{"sql": "", "explanation": "数据库中没有电价或电费数据，无法计算电费金额，只能查询鼓风机耗电量（如需可查询耗电量）。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(min(LEAST(r.do_aerobic_1, r.do_aerobic_2))::numeric, 2) AS \"最低溶解氧_mgL\" FROM plant_reading r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND r.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '15 hours' AND r.ts < date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' + interval '18 hours'", "explanation": "查询黄官镇鼓风机故障时段（15点到18点）内所有原始好氧区溶解氧读数的最小值"}
{"sql": "SELECT name AS \"厂站名称\", capacity_m3d AS \"设计规模_立方米每日\" FROM plant WHERE kind = '集镇厂' ORDER BY capacity_m3d DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "查询所有集镇厂，按设计处理规模降序排序并取第一条，得到设计规模最大的集镇厂。"}
{"sql": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS 鼓风机总数, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = '备用') AS 备用台数 FROM device WHERE kind = '鼓风机'", "explanation": "从设备台账中筛选鼓风机，统计总台数及其中备用状态的台数"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, d.kind AS 设备类型
FROM device d
JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%'
ORDER BY d.code
LIMIT 100;", "explanation": "根据厂站名称匹配梁山镇污水处理站，关联设备台账表查询设备编码和类型"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(capacity_m3d)::numeric, 0) AS \"总设计规模_吨每日\" FROM plant;", "explanation": "对厂站表的 capacity_m3d 求和得到全区所有厂站设计处理规模合计。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(r.current_a::numeric, 2) AS "电流(A)"
FROM device_reading r
JOIN device d ON d.id = r.device_id
WHERE d.code = 'P01-BL-1'
  AND r.ts <= now()
ORDER BY r.ts DESC
LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "查询中心厂1号鼓风机（P01-BL-1）最近一次监测的电流值"}

{"sql":"SELECT d.code AS \"设备编码\", d.kind AS \"设备类型\", d.model AS \"设备型号\", round(d.rated_kw::numeric, 2) AS \"额定功率_kW\", p.name AS \"所属厂站\" FROM device d JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id WHERE d.rated_kw = (SELECT MAX(rated_kw) FROM device) ORDER BY d.rated_kw DESC, d.code LIMIT 10;","explanation":"查询设备台账中额定功率等于最大额定功率的设备，并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS "厂站名称", round(r.tn_out::numeric, 2) AS "出水总氮_mg_L"
FROM plant_reading r
JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE r.ts <= now()
  AND r.ts = (SELECT MAX(r2.ts) FROM plant_reading r2 WHERE r2.plant_id = r.plant_id)
ORDER BY r.tn_out DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "查询每个厂站最新一条实时记录，按出水总氮降序取第一，即当前出水总氮最高的厂站"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(pr.cod_in)::numeric, 2) AS \"进水COD平均值(mg/L)\" FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '12 hours';", "explanation": "查询中心厂今天0点到12点的小时进水COD均值，按小时表聚合求平均。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round((sum(r.inflow_m3h) / 6)::numeric, 1) AS \"平均每天处理水量(m³)\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND r.hour >= '2026-10-30' AND r.hour < '2026-11-05';", "explanation": "汇总梁山镇污水处理站在10月30日至11月4日的小时进水量并除以6天得到日均处理水量"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(blower_kw)::numeric, 2) AS "鼓风机总耗电量_kWh", round((sum(blower_kw) / NULLIF(sum(inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 3) AS "吨水曝气电耗_kWh_per_m3"
FROM plant_reading_1h
WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "查询昨日所有厂站小时数据，汇总鼓风机耗电量，并除以处理水量得到吨水曝气电耗"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS \"最高气温\", round(min(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS \"最低气温\" FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "查询昨天自然日的最高和最低气温"}

{"sql": "SELECT COALESCE(round(sum(carbon_dose_kgh)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "碳源投加量_kg",
       COALESCE(round(sum(pac_dose_kgh)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "PAC投加量_kg"
FROM plant_reading_1h
WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND hour < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '7 days';", "explanation": "按小时表汇总本周所有厂站的碳源与PAC投加量"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS \"厂站名称\", round(COALESCE(SUM(pr.inflow_m3h), 0)::numeric, 0) AS \"处理水量(m³)\" FROM plant p LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h pr ON p.id = pr.plant_id AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND pr.hour < now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY p.id;", "explanation": "筛选本周开始到当前小时前的小时数据，按厂站汇总进水流量作为处理水量。"}

{"sql": "SELECT plant.name AS \"厂站名称\", round(avg(pr.nh3n_in)::numeric, 2) AS \"平均进水氨氮(mg/L)\" FROM plant LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h pr ON pr.plant_id = plant.id AND pr.hour >= now() - interval '24 hours' AND pr.hour < now() GROUP BY plant.id, plant.name ORDER BY plant.id;", "explanation": "查询过去24小时各厂进水氨氮小时均值的平均"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, round(avg(r.mlss)::numeric, 1) AS 平均污泥浓度_mgL FROM plant p JOIN plant_reading r ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY p.name;", "explanation": "plant_reading_1h 无 mlss 字段，故查询 plant_reading 原始表过去7天按厂站聚合平均污泥浓度。"}

{"sql": "SELECT to_char(pr.hour, 'HH24:00') AS \"小时\", round(pr.tp_out::numeric, 3) AS \"出水总磷均值(mg/L)\" FROM plant_reading_1h pr JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%' AND pr.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08' AND pr.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08' ORDER BY pr.hour;", "explanation": "按小时粒度查询协税镇污水处理站在11月3日每个整点的出水总磷小时均值，使用plant_reading_1h表并关联厂站名称。"}

{"sql": "SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS \"日期\", round(avg(temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS \"平均气温(℃)\" FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-11-01'::date AND ts < '2026-11-05'::date GROUP BY date_trunc('day', ts) ORDER BY 1;", "explanation": "按天聚合11月1日至4日的气温数据，计算每日平均气温"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round(avg(r.cod_out)::numeric, 2) AS 平均出水COD_mgL
FROM plant_reading_1h r
JOIN plant p ON r.plant_id = p.id
WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY avg(r.cod_out) DESC
LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "过去7天按厂站计算小时出水COD平均值，排序取最高者"}

{"sql": "SELECT
  hour AS "小时",
  round(SUM(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 2) AS "处理水量（m³）"
FROM plant_reading_1h
WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now())
  AND hour < date_trunc('day', now()) + interval '1 day'
GROUP BY hour
ORDER BY hour;", "explanation": "按小时汇总今天所有厂站的进水流量合计，即全区每小时处理水量"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS "厂站名称", round(SUM(r.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 2) AS "处理水量(m³)"
FROM plant_reading_1h r
JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id
WHERE r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY SUM(r.inflow_m3h) DESC
LIMIT 3;", "explanation": "聚合昨日各厂站小时处理水量，按总量降序取前三名"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, r.hour AS 时间, round(r.cod_out::numeric, 2) AS 出水COD_mgL FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' ORDER BY r.cod_out DESC LIMIT 1;", "explanation": "查询过去7天小时级出水COD最高的一条记录，关联厂站名称并降序取第一条。"}

{"sql": "WITH target AS (
  SELECT r.nh3n_out_max
  FROM plant_reading_1h r
  JOIN plant p ON r.plant_id = p.id
  WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官镇%'
    AND r.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
    AND r.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
    AND r.nh3n_out_max > 5
)
SELECT count(*) AS 超标小时数,
       round(max(nh3n_out_max)::numeric, 2) AS 最高氨氮_mg_L
FROM target;", "explanation": "按昨天（11月4日）筛选黄官镇小时数据，用氨氮小时最大值判断超标并统计小时数和峰值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS "超标小时数"
FROM plant_reading_1h
WHERE hour >= date_trunc('week', now())
  AND hour < now()
  AND tp_out_max > 0.5", "explanation": "统计本周（从周一0点至当前时间）所有厂站小时数据中出水总磷最大值超过0.5mg/L的小时数"}

{
  "sql": "WITH daily AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('day', hour) AS day,
         round(sum(inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS total_water
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '7 days'
    AND hour < date_trunc('day', now())
  GROUP BY day
)
SELECT to_char(day, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "日期",
       total_water AS "处理水量(m³)"
FROM daily
ORDER BY total_water DESC
LIMIT 1;",
  "explanation": "汇总过去7个完整自然日全区所有厂站的小时处理水量，取总量最大的一天。"
}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站名称, round((SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0))::numeric, 3) AS 吨水曝气电耗_kWh_m3 FROM plant_reading_1h h JOIN plant p ON p.id = h.plant_id WHERE h.hour >= date_trunc('week', now()) AND h.hour < now() GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY (SUM(h.blower_kw) / NULLIF(SUM(h.inflow_m3h), 0)) ASC LIMIT 2;", "explanation": "汇总本周各厂鼓风机电耗与处理水量，按吨水曝气电耗升序取最低两个厂。"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(avg(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS \"出水总氮平均值_mg/L\", round(max(r.tn_out)::numeric, 2) AS \"最大小时均值_mg/L\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days'", "explanation": "从小时均值表中筛选中心厂过去7天数据，对出水总氮取平均值和最大值。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS \"设备编码\", round(max(dr.vibration_mms)::numeric, 2) AS \"最大振动(mm/s)\" FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON d.id = dr.device_id WHERE d.kind = '鼓风机' AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY max(dr.vibration_mms) DESC LIMIT 1", "explanation": "关联设备台账与设备监测数据，过滤鼓风机并统计过去7天每台的最大振动值，取最高一台。"}

{"sql": "SELECT count(*) AS \"停机分钟数\" FROM device_reading dr JOIN device d ON dr.device_id = d.id JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id WHERE p.name LIKE '%黄官%' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.code LIKE '%-BL-1' AND dr.running = false AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day' AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())", "explanation": "查询黄官镇1号鼓风机在昨天（11月4日）内所有运行状态为 false 的记录，因每分钟一条数据，记录数即为停机分钟数。"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS "设备编码", round(avg(dr.current_a)::numeric, 2) AS "平均电流_A"
FROM device_reading dr
JOIN device d ON dr.device_id = d.id
JOIN plant p ON d.plant_id = p.id
WHERE p.kind = '中心厂'
  AND d.kind = '提升泵'
  AND dr.running = true
  AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY d.id, d.code
ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "查询昨天中心厂各提升泵在运行状态下的平均电流，按设备编码分组返回"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.name AS 厂站, count(dr.ts) AS 运行分钟数
FROM plant p
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.plant_id = p.id AND d.kind = '污泥泵'
LEFT JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id
  AND dr.running = true
  AND dr.ts >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND dr.ts < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.name
ORDER BY p.name;", "explanation": "关联设备台账与每分钟运行数据，按厂站统计昨天污泥泵 running 记录数作为运行分钟数"}

{"sql": "SELECT d.code AS 设备编码, round(avg(dr.temp_c)::numeric, 1) AS 平均温度 FROM device d JOIN plant p ON p.id = d.plant_id JOIN device_reading dr ON dr.device_id = d.id WHERE p.kind = '中心厂' AND d.kind = '鼓风机' AND d.status = '运行' AND dr.running = true AND dr.ts >= now() - interval '24 hours' GROUP BY d.code ORDER BY d.code", "explanation": "关联设备台账与设备运行数据，筛选中心厂当前运行中的鼓风机在过去24小时内的运行记录，按设备编码分组计算平均温度。"}
{"sql": "SELECT round(max(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2) AS \"最大降雨强度\" FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31'::timestamptz AND ts < '2026-11-01'::timestamptz", "explanation": "查询2026年10月31日当天天气表中的最大小时降雨强度"}

{"sql": "SELECT min(ts) AS 开始时间, max(ts) AS 结束时间 FROM weather WHERE ts >= '2026-10-31'::timestamptz AND ts < '2026-11-01'::timestamptz AND rain_mm_h > 0;", "explanation": "查询10月31日降雨强度大于0的最早和最晚时间戳，作为降雨开始和结束时间"}

{"sql":"SELECT round((COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.hour >= '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz AND r.hour < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END),0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN r.hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz AND r.hour < '2026-10-31 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END),0))::numeric, 2) AS \"处理水量差值_立方米\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant p ON p.id = r.plant_id WHERE p.name LIKE '%梁山镇%' AND r.hour >= '2026-10-30 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz AND r.hour < '2026-11-01 00:00:00+08'::timestamptz","explanation":"对比梁山镇10月31日与10月30日的小时处理水量合计，计算差值"}

{"sql": "SELECT round(max(tp_out_max)::numeric, 3) AS "最高出水总磷_mg/L"
FROM plant_reading_1h pr
JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
WHERE p.name LIKE '%协税%'
  AND pr.hour >= '2026-11-03 00:00:00+08'
  AND pr.hour < '2026-11-04 00:00:00+08';", "explanation": "从小时均值表中筛选协税镇11月3日的数据，取出水总磷小时最大值中的最大。"}

{
  "sql": "WITH stats AS (
  SELECT plant_id,
         AVG(tn_in) AS avg_tn_in,
         AVG(tn_out) AS avg_tn_out
  FROM plant_reading_1h
  WHERE hour >= now() - interval '7 days'
  GROUP BY plant_id
)
SELECT p.name AS "厂站名称",
       ROUND(((s.avg_tn_in - s.avg_tn_out) / NULLIF(s.avg_tn_in, 0) * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "总氮去除率(%)"
FROM stats s
JOIN plant p ON p.id = s.plant_id
ORDER BY p.id;",
  "explanation": "取过去7天各厂进水总氮与出水总氮的小时均值，计算去除率百分比。"
}

{
  "sql": "SELECT p.name AS "厂站名称", round((SUM(pr.inflow_m3h) / p.capacity_m3d * 100)::numeric, 2) AS "负荷率_百分比"
FROM plant p
LEFT JOIN plant_reading_1h pr
  ON p.id = pr.plant_id
 AND pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
 AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.capacity_m3d
ORDER BY p.id",
  "explanation": "查询昨天自然日各厂小时处理水量总和，除以设计规模计算负荷率百分比"
}

{"sql": "SELECT round(sum(CASE WHEN pl.kind='中心厂' THEN r.inflow_m3h ELSE 0 END) / sum(r.inflow_m3h) * 100, 2) AS \"中心厂处理水量占比(%)\" FROM plant_reading_1h r JOIN plant pl ON r.plant_id=pl.id WHERE r.hour >= now() - interval '7 days' AND r.hour <= now();", "explanation": "汇总过去7天小时级处理水量，用条件聚合计算中心厂占全区总量的百分比。"}

{"sql": "SELECT p.process AS "工艺", round(sum(pr.inflow_m3h)::numeric, 0) AS "处理水量(m³)"
FROM plant_reading_1h pr
JOIN plant p ON p.id = pr.plant_id
WHERE pr.hour >= date_trunc('day', now()) - interval '1 day'
  AND pr.hour < date_trunc('day', now())
  AND p.process IN ('A2O','氧化沟')
GROUP BY p.process
ORDER BY p.process", "explanation": "按昨天的小时数据关联厂站工艺，分别汇总A2O和氧化沟工艺的处理水量"}

{"sql": "SELECT COALESCE(round(SUM(rain_mm_h)::numeric, 2), 0) AS \"下周总降雨量(mm)\", CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(rain_mm_h), 0) > 0 THEN '有雨' ELSE '无雨' END AS \"是否有雨\" FROM weather WHERE ts >= date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '7 days' AND ts < date_trunc('week', now()) + interval '14 days';", "explanation": "查询下周（2026-11-09至2026-11-15）南郑区气象数据，统计降雨量并判断是否下雨"}
